title: XTI Aerospace Appoints Unusual Machines CEO Dr. Allan Evans to Serve as Chairman of its Board of Directors

body_markdown:
DALLAS


, Oct. 14, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- XTI Aerospace, Inc. (Nasdaq: XTIA) ("XTI Aerospace," "XTI" or the "Company"), an aerospace and advanced technology platform and parent company of Drone Nerds, LLC, ("Drone Nerds"), a leading drone solutions platform serving commercial, enterprise and government customers, today announced the appointment of Dr. Allan Evans as a director and Chairman of its Board of Directors. His addition returns the Board to five members. In connection with Dr. Evans' appointment as Chairman, the Board designated Mr. Ornstein as Vice Chairman of the Board.


"We are very pleased to welcome Allan to XTI's Board," said Jonathan Ornstein, XTI Aerospace's Vice Chairman. "Allan brings deep engineering expertise, proven business development and corporate strategy experience, as well as a firsthand understanding of the domestic supply chain for the growing U.S. drone industry. We look forward to leveraging his experience at Unusual Machines as we seek to help advance the next generation of unmanned operations across complex environments."


Dr. Evans, age 43, currently serves as Chief Executive Officer and a director of Unusual Machines, Inc. (NYSE American: UMAC), positions he has held since December 2023. From 2021 to 2023 he was Chief Operating Officer of Red Cat Holdings, Inc., a drone technology company and previously served as Chief Executive Officer of Fat Shark from 2017 until its acquisition by Red Cat in 2020. Dr. Evans received his PhD in Electrical Engineering from the University of Michigan.


Jeremy Schneiderman, Interim CEO, added, "XTI Aerospace and Drone Nerds are well‑positioned to expand our leadership in the U.S. enterprise drone market, and Allan's industry expertise, relationships, and strategic insight will be invaluable as we capitalize on that opportunity."


"I am excited to work with Jeremy, XTI's board, and the entire executive team as we focus on leveraging the Company's leadership position in the U.S. drone market during this critical transition away from foreign manufacturers," said Dr. Evans. "We have a unique opportunity to dramatically grow the business and drive meaningful outcomes for our partners and shareholders."


**About XTI Aerospace, Inc.**


XTI Aerospace, Inc. ("XTI") (Nasdaq: XTIA) is focused on building a leading platform for commercial and government drone adoption in the growing unmanned aircraft systems ("UAS") industry. Through its subsidiary, Drone Nerds, LLC, XTI supports enterprise and government customers in sectors including public safety, agriculture, construction, and energy across the drone program lifecycle, from hardware sourcing and deployment to training, service, repair, and the proprietary Always Flying™ program. Its established U.S. customer base and reputation as a trusted solutions provider position the company as a go-to-market partner for drone manufacturers and software developers seeking to scale in the domestic market.
